description: The headless tabs core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. createTabs is the runes state machine behind SvTabs: roving arrow-key focus, automatic or manual activation and full WAI-ARIA, exposed as tablistProps, tabProps and panelProps. One core drives the styled SvTabs and a custom segmented control, both bound to a single active id with a readout.

faq.question: What links a tab to its panel?
faq.answer: tabProps(id) and panelProps(id) generate matching ids for aria-controls and aria-labelledby, so any pair of elements becomes an accessible tab and panel.

faq.question: What is manual activation?
faq.answer: Arrow keys move focus without selecting; Enter or Space selects. Automatic activation selects as focus moves. The core supports both and the styled component defaults to automatic.

faq.question: Can two renders show the same active tab?
faq.answer: Yes. The demo's segmented control and SvTabs share one core, so clicking either updates both and the bound id.
